name: Evening Glow
source:
Masato is an ordinary university student in his native seaside town. He doesn't like to stand out and does not participate in bullying. He never got a girlfriend after being turned down by girl at school. There are only two boys who can be considered "friends". Days pass peacefully in their company, and second college year begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
真人是一名普通的大学生，生活在家乡的海滨小镇。他不喜欢出风头，也不参与霸凌。在学校被女孩拒绝后，他就再也没有交过女朋友。只有两个男生可以算是“朋友”。在他们的陪伴下日子平静地度过，大二生活开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
